meta.auc_orientation: larger dD, rhoA, radA, nA and smaller C = off-atom; AUC = P(off > on) + ties/2
meta.dauc_ci: paired class-stratified bootstrap over samples of the stored out-of-fold predictions (no refit), repeats averaged inside each resample; refit_oob = refit on the resample, AUC on out-of-bag samples
meta.lr_test: in-sample ML LR chi2 (1 df); Firth penalised LR where the MLE does not exist; Holm over the field-error family of each model
meta.c_window: C_i = sum_{j=j0}^{i-1} (1 - (rhoA_j + rhoA_{j+1})/2) log(sigma_j/sigma_{j+1}); uses rhoA up to index i only
meta.history_control: Hist_i = sum_{j=j0}^{i-1} (log dD_j + log dD_{j+1})/2 log(sigma_j/sigma_{j+1}); 'C|hist' tests C over (log dD_i, Hist_i)
meta.class_check: Firth LR of the candidate given log dD + class dummies
